actualNative.description: The unchanged original continues through genuine tick interrupts, main_task and app_main, then RTC/QMI initialization and Wi-Fi startup. It stops on the next unimplemented clock-gate combination; LCD/SD remain untouched.

contracts: COEX NUM49 with XTAL48 gives divisor50 and exact pre-gate ratio48000000/50=960000Hz. This is source/divider configuration, not a modeled COEX/RF/MAC clock or ready signal.

USB exact offsets08/0c/10/14 are qualified by validated ROM, explicit cold profile, known APB and PLL48, and no pending reset. The named cold PCR_USB CLK_EN1/RST_EN0 is immutable because every PCR_USB+94 access rejects.

USB RAW3 is a sticky latch with cold value1, separately from FIFO occupancy. C5 TRM R/WTC/SS without SC and closure of all16 named events support retention across TX/WR_DONE. No host, token, SOF, physical line, bus-reset or IRQ producer is added.
Only SOF ENA/CLR masks0/2 are accepted. RAW write, CLR3, ENA3, CLR read, unknown offsets/clocks and unsupported PCR mutators reject before mutation. No packet is consumed by a monitor read or clear.

Exact owned refusals in the strict profile are ModelLimit and preserve guest destination/CSR state; adjacent and off-profile unknown words retain prior mapping. Old-watchdog service precedes partial monitor/divider writes.
CPU reset retains USB digital history; the declared HP fresh reset restores it. This does not model physical USB reset, PHY settling, host enumeration or CLR3 reassertion timing.

Positive plain/UnitCost guests execute RAW read, CLR2 store and RAW read with both pristine and real Bus-prepared sealed FIFO states. Preparing TX/WR_DONE is fixture setup, not part of that three-instruction guest.
The pure optional native USB observation runs after guest stop without MMIO, pumping, time advancement or FIFO/flag mutation.
The next MODEM_LPCON CLK_CONF value3 requests COEX_EN bit1 and WIFIPWR_EN bit0, leaving I2C_MST_EN bit2 clear. It does not select the SYSCON+04 bit12 160MHz source; no new readiness is inferred.

limits: No C5 product acceptance or publication: LCD nonzero pixels0, SD commands0, buttons/TF persistence unverified.
RTC/QMI initialization logs do not establish all sensor functions; SHTC3 still fails and its printed ID is not a success.

The541 focused checks and both Clippy runs do not replace final default-LTO workspace CI, identical-work CPU controls, new production WASM, real browser validation or independent product acceptance.
